Specification of Persistency
AUTOSAR AP R23-11
7.2.4 Security Concepts
The
Persistency
supports protection of the authenticity and confidentiality of data
stored in a
Key-Value Storage
or
File Storage
. Which kind of protection is
applied and the used algorithms are decided at deployment time. The
application
is not aware of this fact.
If confidentiality of data shall be protected, a
storage
or an
element
of a
storage
are encrypted after the creation of the
storage
and when the
storage
is saved, and
are decrypted when a
storage
is opened. Therefore, only encrypted data is stored
persistently. In case of a read-only
storage
, encryption is done only once during
installation, decryption is done every time the
storage
is opened.
If authenticity of data shall be protected, a message authentication code (
MAC
) is gen-
erated after the creation of a
storage
and when the
storage
is saved, and verified
when the
storage
is opened. Therefore, unauthorized modifications to the
storage
can be detected.
In case of a read-only
storage
, it is also possible to protect the authenticity of the
storage
(or an
element
therein) by calculating a hash value of the data to be pro-
tected and comparing this calculated value to a hash value provided in the
manifest
.
This assumes that the authenticity of the processed manifest is protected using other
mechanisms (like secure boot).
If authenticity and confidentiality shall be protected, authenticated encryption schemes
(like AES GCM) can be used.
